text:
ana: Heads up - doing a quick audit of onboarding READMEs and found at least 6 spots where the JS snippet shows `const API_KEY = 'REPLACE_ME'` and then sticks it into fetch headers. This is a copy/paste trap.

ryan: ugh. where did those come from? templates maybe?

tori: likely from the old docs exporter that generated plain curl -> fetch conversions. We should fix both the static files and the generator.

ana: Agreed. My plan: replace examples with the SDK pattern + env var, and add a short note about never pasting secrets. e.g. node: `const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` and python: `client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))`.

ryan: Also add a one-liner about local dev token rotation: "Use `direnv` or .env.local (gitignored). Don't check tokens into source." People copy entire README including .env examples.

tori: Can we also standardize the env var name? I vote for REDWOOD_API_KEY to be explicit.

ana: +1 REDWOOD_API_KEY. I'll update all READMEs and add a small section in CONTRIBUTING: "Examples must not include plaintext keys; prefer SDK constructor usage."

ci-bot: lint/docs: scanning changed docs for disallowed patterns...

ci-bot: found matches in samples/js-widget/README.md: `REPLACE_ME`

ana: pushing a fix for that file now.

doc-bot: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/678 — branch patch/remove-inline-keys. Includes tests to fail if `REPLACE_ME`, `YOUR_KEY`, `INSERT_KEY` appear in rendered docs.

ryan: Nice. Tori, can you take the docs generator change? Replace the fetch conversion logic to emit SDK-first examples and include a short comment about retries/backoff.

tori: On it. I'll also add a unit test that generates sample and asserts SDK usage present.

ana: After we merge, drop a short note in #general to remind external contributors to use the SDK snippets.

ci-bot: PR builds: preview available at https://deploy.preview/678. Docs lint now passing on branch.

doc-bot: PR merged into main. 7 files changed.

ryan: Sweet. I'll run a repo-wide grep across examples/ and widget/ and open follow-ups for anything else. Thanks!
